description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
Leveler enters the battlefield, exiling your library.
Cast Lokhust Heavy Destroyer by paying {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Lokhust Heavy Destroyer enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature, and you to sacrifice Lokhust Heavy Destroyer.
Lokhust Heavy Destroyer dies, triggering Liliana, causing you to return Lokhust Heavy Destroyer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
